metadata.state_timing: state and aux at tick k; aux advances before RK4 and is held through its stages; cmd_* drives that step (reset commands at tick 0)
metadata.wheel_profile_hash_convention: profile_sha256 is canonical JSON for the selected aircraft profile; input_sha256 is SHA-256 of exact wheel_profiles.json bytes

configuration.meaning: simulation ticks; default warmup is 10 simulated seconds and default sample is 60 simulated seconds, not real-time qualification

performance.host: Shared Linux KVM development host; no simultaneous agent benchmark/render run during this campaign. Not dedicated target hardware.

archive.relocation: Archive sidecars extracted into a fresh directory; executable hard-linked after archived executable bytes matched the tested artifact hash.

relocated_native_probe.scope: CPU only: deterministic raw-input seam, FlightSession._physics_process then Simulation._physics_process including collision and accepted-step callbacks. Detached session, no render/audio/OS input/scheduler. Durations are simulated ticks, not wall-clock warmup/sample. Hashing, backend and native counter checks run outside per-tick timing and can perturb later ticks; the sample loop wall time includes them. Fingerprint covers types, shapes and numeric simulation arrays at the initial boundary and every warmup and sample tick, not all Session/event/checkpoint state. No Gate P or native frame qualification claim.

loader.earlier_attempt: The migrated-cache case hit its unchanged 30-second deadline during concurrent shared-host workloads; the complete repeat passed all 19 cases.

rebind.method: Candidate replays of the retained tapes on two disposable copies differing only in the solver directories (accepted rev vs current tree); CSV bytes compared.
rebind.limits: Parity on these tapes only; not exact replay, not a new qualification, not physical validation.

additional_checks.workflow: actionlint, bash syntax, nine CI partition and thirteen export-identity checks passed locally; remote CI not run.

limitations: Detached production-session timing excludes rendering, audio, OS input and scheduling; identity checks outside each stopwatch can perturb subsequent ticks.
Native p95 exceeds 500 us on this host; the relative CPU gain does not close Gate P or 1080p qualification.
Software equivalence is not physical validation; native weather/fleet coverage and Windows/macOS remain separate work.
Local package qualifies NK-3. The full cross-platform export pipeline and separate ground-vehicle native artifacts are wired in CI but were not executed as a complete local release pipeline.
Existing broad-suite fixed-brake failure predates NK-3 and reproduced against the reference control; no frozen/golden data was regenerated.
Raw performance reports and logs remain at the recorded local tmp paths; this record retains their hashes, completion identities and reduced measurements.
